name: Grounded adventure prototypes
body: Dean (2026-11-16): after play-testing, the game has more action-adventure than puzzle-platformer in it (think The Last of Us without combat). Movement should be fairly grounded and realistic, and challenge should come from places and small games rather than gaps. Prototype: a train station level, minigames (eating, collecting Japanese words and phrases, more), player-only climbing the companion cannot do (she helps the player bypass climbs by opening another route), and grounded movement tuning. The companion is the player's equal, never commanded: another thread owns her behaviour (the team_beat marker) and the rule that a level completes only with her beside the player. Cloud has no nox or mist, so nothing here is compiled or run until Dean plays it.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the six rooms and the crossing: the game feels like an action adventure (grounded movement, challenge from places and small games), not a puzzle platformer.

plan: 1. Cards. 2. Grounded feel profile and momentum. 3. Climbing and the world kind climb_surface. 4. Word and food minigames. 5. Trains. 6. The climb room, word market and station worlds. 7. Host tests. 8. Docs, decisions, checklist, ideas note.
